input_oneliner: POD3 hip fracture repair, 79F, sudden dyspnea and right-sided pleuritic pain 20 min ago, HR 112, RR 26, sat 91% RA

reference_targets_freetext.item: Calf circumference asymmetry >3 cm (10 cm below tibial tuberosity), tenderness, or superficial venous distension
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Clinical DVT signs are the strongest bedside predictor of PE

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about hemoptysis, prior VTE, and syncope or presyncope with the event; document immobility since surgery (Wells/Geneva history items)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Pretest probability components that can be obtained at bedside

reference_targets_freetext.item: Compare breath sounds side to side; percuss for unilateral hyperresonance or dullness
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Detects pneumothorax or effusion/consolidation as alternative causes

reference_targets_freetext.item: Focal consolidation: egophony, bronchial breath sounds, dullness to percussion; Focal crackles
Ask about fever, rigors, and productive cough
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Infective history supports pneumonia over PE
Elevated JVP suggests right heart strain from a large PE

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about chest pressure character, exertional pattern, and diaphoresis
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Screens for ACS as a post-operative alternative

should_not_recommend: Homan's sign as a rule-in or rule-out for DVT
Delay examination pending CT pulmonary angiogram result
Attribute to post-operative atelectasis without examining legs and comparing breath sounds
